rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, comments appropriately on possible partial contraction, ICM compactness, TE adequacy, and zona thinning; minor limitation is some hedging and inability to verify all fine features from a static image.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, prior IVF history, diagnosis, endometrial thickness, oocyte maturity, sperm parameters, and protocol context with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to age and embryo grade; only minor issue is slight ambiguity between implantation and clinical pregnancy terminology.

Recommendations are strongly aligned with IVF best practices: supports SET in a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst, avoids unsupported add-ons, and appropriately cautions against premature PGT-A/ERA use.

Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including luteal support adherence, lifestyle guidance, uterine evaluation, and review of embryology details if unsuccessful.
